Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: After going a few years without a grill, I choose Weber because of the size which is perfect for 2 people. I like the cast grates which can be flipped over so either side may be used. It lights without fail using the battery powered spark generator. The grease tray is a great feature. The warranty seems great. I haven’t had to use the warranty and I hope I never have to. The hanger which secures the LP tank has the integrated spring gage which helps me know about how much gas is remaining. I’m sure it’s not that accurate, but it’s better than having no idea at all.

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Have been looking for a grill for awhile, needed to replace my Weber charcoal grill after a move across the country. The Spirit II was perfect, just the right size for my family and our new home. Convenient features, super easy to use and it looks great! Not too mention all of the collateral material I received from Weber. Great grill from a great company! 2nd time buyers!
Results.Title: Awesome Grill!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText: Hands down, this is just the best grill I've ever owned!  Did a lot of online research which was validated by a HD associate & we couldn't be happier with this purchase.  Grill was amazingly packed & assembly was a snap - am really impressed with the quality / sturdiness of the components...this thing should last for years & years.  The best part is it's performance - grill preheats to 500 degrees in no time, grates are heavy duty cast iron & easy to clean, burners heat evenly across the board, i.e. no obvious hot/cold spots, burner controls are consistent / responsive, and the drip tray design is outstanding.  Was concerned whether the size of this model would be sufficient for our family of 4 with occasional guests, but grilling area is not noticeably different than our previous 3-burner grill, so no worries at all. We could have spent a lot more money for a bunch of bells / whistles that we'd probably never use, but I highly doubt that we could have found a better quality grill for the money...great job, Weber!
Results.Title: Grilling Has Never Been So Easy!

Results.OriginalProductName: Spirit II E-210 Gas Grill (Liquid Propane)
Results.ReviewText:
This is a great grill, but not perfect.  Two issues of note, first is movement.  As you know there is no secure place to grasp the grill for movement on the Left side.  The folding tray, while convenient, is not sturdy for moving the grill and distance.  There are two vertical bolts available on the rear frame just begging for a handle to be added. 
Second, there is a cold spot on the Left Front grate just above the burner igniter.  Any food placed on the Left Front grate cooks unevenly and at a much less temperature. 
Serious cooking compensations are required with any foods placed in this location.
Results.Title: Great Grill... but not perfect

Results.ReviewText: The grill has been in use now and works well. Assembly was relatively straightforward and took about 1.5 hours. My only other complaint is the cheap little plastic "star" pieces used to cover the cotter pins for the wheels. Roll the grill 2 feet and one side always pops off from the movement of the axle. I gave the grille a 4 star rating, but really feels it deserves a 3.5 for all the little shortcomings.

Results.ReviewText:
We bought the grill anticipating the quality we'd heard so much about. For the most part we've experienced that with the grilling characteristics. The attention to detail on most features are great... until I go to move the grill each time we use it. We keep the grill covered and against the house until we use it, then we move it about 8-10 feet away from the house further out on our deck. The left fold-down table, intended to be used to lift and roll the grill worked marginally the first 3-4 times (worth a 4-star rating if it had not got worse) and has since gone downhill to become unusable as the means to maneuver the grill. It's unfortunate that moving the grill comes before I actually use the grill because I start out frustrated before I can begin grilling. That small detail starts our frequent grilling experience (the actual grilling I'm very pleased with) out on the wrong foot each time.

I would recommend this grill with the caveat that, if you intend to move the grill around at all, you'll need to add a thick washer to each peg that the left table hooks on, and tighten it down, which in effect negates the easy fold-ability of that left table.

Results.ReviewText:
We had a three burner grill that needed replacing so we started comparing grills and realized that 80 - 90% of the time we grill for the 2 of us so we looked at 2 burner grills and picked this one based on size, style, features and price.

As we now keep grill inside garage when not in use, we did not have to upgrade to higher price grill too keep outside, even though if you keep covered, this one could stay outside. Like the larger wheels to help move around.

For the two of us, this is just right for us and cooks the food evenly. Very fuel efficient compared to our 3 burner unit we had. Learning to trust the fuel gauge indicator because it is new to us.

Open the door to the world of grilling with crazy good food and friends coming together. Equipped with the powerful GS4 grilling system, this two burner gas grill is your entry to the Weber family and to everyday grilling.
